title: Modern Event Deck 2014: card flavor text

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: Named in the card title Inquisition of Kozilek.

entities.name: Nim
entities.description: Creatures that raid homes without warning.

entities.name: Jharic
entities.description: A knight who returned from Grixis changed, with a haunted look, destroying foes with unholy glee.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A dark place from which Jharic returned changed.

entities.name: Knight-Captain Wyhorn
entities.description: A knight-captain who observed Jharic's change.

entities.name: Hollowhenge
entities.description: A place whose murdered inhabitants impart their terror to the living.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A world that preserves Sorin Markov's past associates, victims and mistakes.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker whose creation kept Innistrad in balance for centuries.

entities.name: Nulakam the Archivist
entities.description: An archivist who speaks of the ringing spires of the City of Brass.

entities.name: City of Brass
entities.description: A place of much learning with ringing spires few can endure.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: A hydra-god elves believe sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A land beneath which Progenitus is believed to sleep.

entities.name: Elves
entities.description: Believers that Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: An organization employing the torturer Hooks.

entities.name: Kataki
entities.description: A kami once prayed to for sharp swords and hard armor before the war.

entities.name: Kenzo the Hardhearted
entities.description: A warrior lamenting the loss of Kataki's blessing against the kami hordes.

entities.name: Azax-Azog, the Demon Thane
entities.description: A demon thane who serves Phyrexia.

events.summary: Jharic returns from Grixis changed and destroys enemies with unholy glee.
events.quote: Jharic returned from Grixis changed, a haunted look in her eyes.

events.summary: Sorin Markov laments that only the shadow of his creation, which kept Innistrad in balance, remains.
events.quote: For centuries my creation kept this world in balance. Now only her shadow remains.

events.summary: Kataki's blessing is lost during the war, leaving weapons useless against the kami hordes.
events.quote: Without his blessing our weapons are all but useless against the kami hordes.

relations.quote: Elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya
Before the war, we prayed to Kataki to sharpen our swords and harden our armor.

rejected.summary: The inhabitants of Hollowhenge are murdered and their ghosts impart terror to the living.
rejected.quote: The murdered inhabitants of Hollowhenge impart to the living the terror they felt in death.
